about: How We Soar is a VR flight experience that lets you take up the reins of a beautiful, giant Phoenix and explore an enchanting papercraft world. Seated on the back of this mythical creature, fly throughout the diaries and works of the 'Author'. Reconstruct and bring life to the pages of his creations, uncovering his personal story as you soar.

How We Soar is powered by Unreal Engine 4 and exclusive to Sony PlayStation®VR.
